title: Theory to what Mall World is...

classification.theory_summary: Proposes Mall World may be triggered by near-death physiological events during sleep (e.g., stopped breathing) and functions as a 'loading zone for the dead'.
classification.question_topic: Asks if others think Mall World is connected to dangerous body events during sleep / near-death states, and if it could be an afterlife transition zone.
classification.skip_reason: No describable dream scenes/locations/events; only a theory prompted by a partner observing breathing changes during sleep.

meta.author_theory: Mall World dreams may be triggered by dangerous physiological events during sleep (e.g., stopped breathing) and serve as a transitional 'loading zone' for death.

interactions.description: While napping (during the latest Mall World dream), girlfriend observed the dreamer stopped breathing in sleep for nearly a minute, then took small breaths before resuming normal breathing; girlfriend was scared and almost woke him.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post references recurring 'Mall World' dreams but provides no phenomenological description of the dream environment (no locations, layout, lighting, entities in-dream, or events). Only waking-world physiological observation during sleep is extractable as an observation.
